🚨 CVE-2026-108980 - Docker
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Docker
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 8.8
Resumo:
Blinko through 1.8.8 allows directory traversal, overwriting startup files as root, via installPlugin. It builds the plugin install path from an unsanitized name in server/routerTrpc/plugin.ts, and the plugin.installPlugin tRPC procedure is open to any authenticated user. Thus, a name containing ../ sequences writes the downloaded plugin files outside the plugins directory. Because the official Docker image runs as r...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-108980
 
🚨 CVE-2026-108981 - Nginx
 
Criticidade: Baixa
Ferramenta: Nginx
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 3.6
Resumo:
ngx_cache_purge before 3.0.4 can allow file deletion via a symlink attack in certain situations where nginx and a served application (e.g., WordPress) run under the same user account. The attacker must be able to create a symlink inside the cache path. Version 3.0.4 fixes this for the case of a symlink created at an arbitrary earlier time, but does not resolve an applicable TOCTOU race condition. (The ngx_cache_purge...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-108981

🚨 CVE-2026-108599 - Check Point
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Check Point
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 4.7
Resumo:
phi 0.1.1 through 0.28.4 contains an improper link resolution vulnerability that allows malicious repositories to bypass workspace_only_writes by exploiting lexical-only path checks in the permission gate. Attackers can commit symlinks pointing outside the workspace and use prompt injection to make the write tool write attacker-influenced content to external files without approval.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-108599
 
🚨 Attackers Exploit CVSS 10.0 Bricksforge WordPress Flaw Enabling Unauthenticated RCE
 
Criticidade: Baixa
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: 0.0
Resumo:
A maximum-severity security flaw impacting the Bricksforge plugin for WordPress has come under active exploitation in the wild, according to Patchstack. The critical vulnerability in question is CVE-2026-85097 (CVSS score: 10.0), which allows unauthenticated attackers to upload and execute arbitrary PHP code on vulnerable WordPress websites, resulting in remote code execution (RCE).
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/attackers-exploit-cvss-100-bricksforge.html

📰 Inside AvisLoader: A Windows Malware Loader Built to Resist Disruption
 
Criticidade: Alta

Fonte: BleepingComputer
CVSS: N/D

Link: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/inside-avisloader-a-windows-malware-loader-built-to-resist-disruption/

Criticidade: Crítica
Ferramenta: WordPress
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 9.8
Resumo:
Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in rtCamp Inc. rtMedia for WordPress, BuddyPress and bbPress buddypress-media allows Path Traversal.This issue affects rtMedia for WordPress, BuddyPress and bbPress: from n/a through 4.7.13.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-105892
 
🚨 USN-8912-1: Perl DBI module vulnerabilities
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Ubuntu
Fonte: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/rss.xml
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Harsh Raj Singhania discovered that the Perl DBI module did not correctly validate certain attributes. An attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-78030) Harsh Raj Singhania discovered that the Perl DBI module did not correctly handle certain string operations. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service.
Link: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8912-1
